title: Wren and the Smile
author: Cyrus Brightwater
blurb: Oscar Vasquez, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
